import { Candle, Language, Timeframe, MarketInfo } from './types';

const startPrice = 2030.50;
let currentPrice = startPrice;

export const generateInitialData = (count: number, timeframe: Timeframe = '15m'): Candle[] => {
  const data: Candle[] = [];
  const now = new Date();
  
  let intervalMinutes = 15;
  switch(timeframe) {
      case '1m': intervalMinutes = 1; break;
      case '3m': intervalMinutes = 3; break;
      case '5m': intervalMinutes = 5; break;
      case '15m': intervalMinutes = 15; break;
      case '30m': intervalMinutes = 30; break;
      case '1H': intervalMinutes = 60; break;
      case '2H': intervalMinutes = 120; break;
      case '4H': intervalMinutes = 240; break;
      case '8H': intervalMinutes = 480; break;
      case '12H': intervalMinutes = 720; break;
      case '1D': intervalMinutes = 1440; break;
      case '3D': intervalMinutes = 4320; break;
      case '1W': intervalMinutes = 10080; break;
      case '1M': intervalMinutes = 43200; break;
  }

  for (let i = count; i > 0; i--) {
    const time = new Date(now.getTime() - i * intervalMinutes * 60 * 1000); 
    const move = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    const open = currentPrice;
    const close = open + move;
    const high = Math.max(open, close) + Math.random() * 0.5 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    const low = Math.min(open, close) - Math.random() * 0.5 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    currentPrice = close;
    let timeStr = '';
    if (['1D', '3D', '1W', '1M'].includes(timeframe)) {
        timeStr = time.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric' });
    } else {
        timeStr = time.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    }
    data.push({ time: timeStr, open, high, low, close });
  }
  return data;
};

import { Candle, Language, Timeframe, MarketInfo } from './types';

const startPrice = 2030.50;
let currentPrice = startPrice;

export const generateInitialData = (count: number, timeframe: Timeframe = '15m'): Candle[] => {
  const data: Candle[] = [];
  const now = new Date();
  
  let intervalMinutes = 15;
  switch(timeframe) {
      case '1m': intervalMinutes = 1; break;
      case '3m': intervalMinutes = 3; break;
      case '5m': intervalMinutes = 5; break;
      case '15m': intervalMinutes = 15; break;
      case '30m': intervalMinutes = 30; break;
      case '1H': intervalMinutes = 60; break;
      case '2H': intervalMinutes = 120; break;
      case '4H': intervalMinutes = 240; break;
      case '8H': intervalMinutes = 480; break;
      case '12H': intervalMinutes = 720; break;
      case '1D': intervalMinutes = 1440; break;
      case '3D': intervalMinutes = 4320; break;
      case '1W': intervalMinutes = 10080; break;
      case '1M': intervalMinutes = 43200; break;
  }

  for (let i = count; i > 0; i--) {
    const time = new Date(now.getTime() - i * intervalMinutes * 60 * 1000); 
    const move = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    const open = currentPrice;
    const close = open + move;
    const high = Math.max(open, close) + Math.random() * 0.5 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    const low = Math.min(open, close) - Math.random() * 0.5 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    currentPrice = close;
    let timeStr = '';
    if (['1D', '3D', '1W', '1M'].includes(timeframe)) {
        timeStr = time.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric' });
    } else {
        timeStr = time.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    }
    data.push({ time: timeStr, open, high, low, close });
  }
  return data;
};

import { Candle, Language, Timeframe, MarketInfo } from './types';

const startPrice = 2030.50;
let currentPrice = startPrice;

export const generateInitialData = (count: number, timeframe: Timeframe = '15m'): Candle[] => {
  const data: Candle[] = [];
  const now = new Date();
  
  let intervalMinutes = 15;
  switch(timeframe) {
      case '1m': intervalMinutes = 1; break;
      case '3m': intervalMinutes = 3; break;
      case '5m': intervalMinutes = 5; break;
      case '15m': intervalMinutes = 15; break;
      case '30m': intervalMinutes = 30; break;
      case '1H': intervalMinutes = 60; break;
      case '2H': intervalMinutes = 120; break;
      case '4H': intervalMinutes = 240; break;
      case '8H': intervalMinutes = 480; break;
      case '12H': intervalMinutes = 720; break;
      case '1D': intervalMinutes = 1440; break;
      case '3D': intervalMinutes = 4320; break;
      case '1W': intervalMinutes = 10080; break;
      case '1M': intervalMinutes = 43200; break;
  }

  for (let i = count; i > 0; i--) {
    const time = new Date(now.getTime() - i * intervalMinutes * 60 * 1000); 
    const move = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    const open = currentPrice;
    const close = open + move;
    const high = Math.max(open, close) + Math.random() * 0.5 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    const low = Math.min(open, close) - Math.random() * 0.5 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    currentPrice = close;
    let timeStr = '';
    if (['1D', '3D', '1W', '1M'].includes(timeframe)) {
        timeStr = time.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric' });
    } else {
        timeStr = time.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    }
    data.push({ time: timeStr, open, high, low, close });
  }
  return data;
};

import { Candle, Language, Timeframe, MarketInfo } from './types';

const startPrice = 2030.50;
let currentPrice = startPrice;

export const generateInitialData = (count: number, timeframe: Timeframe = '15m'): Candle[] => {
  const data: Candle[] = [];
  const now = new Date();
  
  let intervalMinutes = 15;
  switch(timeframe) {
      case '1m': intervalMinutes = 1; break;
      case '3m': intervalMinutes = 3; break;
      case '5m': intervalMinutes = 5; break;
      case '15m': intervalMinutes = 15; break;
      case '30m': intervalMinutes = 30; break;
      case '1H': intervalMinutes = 60; break;
      case '2H': intervalMinutes = 120; break;
      case '4H': intervalMinutes = 240; break;
      case '8H': intervalMinutes = 480; break;
      case '12H': intervalMinutes = 720; break;
      case '1D': intervalMinutes = 1440; break;
      case '3D': intervalMinutes = 4320; break;
      case '1W': intervalMinutes = 10080; break;
      case '1M': intervalMinutes = 43200; break;
  }

  for (let i = count; i > 0; i--) {
    const time = new Date(now.getTime() - i * intervalMinutes * 60 * 1000); 
    const move = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    const open = currentPrice;
    const close = open + move;
    const high = Math.max(open, close) + Math.random() * 0.5 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    const low = Math.min(open, close) - Math.random() * 0.5 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    currentPrice = close;
    let timeStr = '';
    if (['1D', '3D', '1W', '1M'].includes(timeframe)) {
        timeStr = time.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric' });
    } else {
        timeStr = time.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    }
    data.push({ time: timeStr, open, high, low, close });
  }
  return data;
};

export const INITIAL_BALANCE = 10000.00;

payload.text: 问一个问题，不做任何修改。请问，当前网页 app 的前端框架是什么？

**Examining Frontend Framework**

I've got the question about the web app's frontend framework locked in.  Currently, I'm parsing the codebase, specifically focusing on `index.tsx`. It seems `import React from` is a key indicator, so I'm honing in on React. No code changes, just pure analysis at this juncture.


**Identifying Components and Tools**

I've determined that the frontend framework is indeed React, specifically version 19. Further exploration reveals the application leverages TypeScript for development and Tailwind CSS for styling.  I am digging into `App.tsx` now. This file uses functional components, including hooks like `useState` and `useEffect`. The `index.html` file confirms that this is using esm.sh for `react` and `react-dom` importmaps.

这个网页 App 使用的前端框架是 **React**（具体版本为 **React 19**）。

它是基于 **TypeScript** 开发的，并采用了 **Tailwind CSS** 进行样式设计，同时利用 **Lucide React** 作为图标库。
充值页面，币种改为可下拉选择，默认 选中USDC，可选择 ETH、ARB、USDT 等其他代币，若充值的币种非 USDC，则确定按钮变成“闪兑”按钮，平台将通过第三方聚合交易接口将充值的币种闪兑为 USDC。显示的钱包可用余额为所选币种的钱包可用余额，根据所选币种切换。

**Exploring Deposit Functionality**

I'm currently focused on the `AccountView` component and refining the deposit process.  The goal is to move beyond the static USDC display and introduce a dynamic currency selection.  Thinking a dropdown is the best approach.  I'm also considering how to handle deposit validation if a currency other than USDC is selected.


**Adding Currency Swapping**

I'm now integrating currency swapping into the deposit flow. The "Confirm" button will become "Quick Swap" (闪兑) when a non-USDC currency is chosen. I'm focusing on the logic to simulate this swap, and displaying the correct balance based on the selected currency, using mock data.  I've updated `constants.ts` with the "Quick Swap" translation and adjusted `AccountViewProps` to handle external balances.


**Developing Currency Selection**

I'm now implementing the currency selection logic. I've defined the supported currencies: USDC, USDT, ETH, and ARB. I'm focusing on managing the `selectedDepositCurrency` state within the `AccountView` component.  The balance display will reflect the selected currency, using mocked balances for now since `externalWalletBalance` is provided for USDC. My current work involves updating the button label based on the selected currency.


**Integrating Balance Logic**

I'm now focusing on balance display for the selected currency.  Since the `externalWalletBalance` prop only provides USDC, I'm developing a helper to provide mocked balances for other currencies (ETH and ARB) to populate the balance display. I'm taking care to not touch any unintended functionality, adhering strictly to the constraints I've been given. The goal is to accurately show the selected currency's balance within the `AccountView`.


**Generating Mock Data**

I'm now generating mock balances for each currency within `AccountView`. This will ensure I have the appropriate balance to display, regardless of the chosen currency. Furthermore, I've incorporated distinct icons and colors for each currency to improve the user interface. I'm excited about getting the code implemented.

import { Candle, Language, Timeframe, MarketInfo } from './types';

const startPrice = 2030.50;
let currentPrice = startPrice;

export const generateInitialData = (count: number, timeframe: Timeframe = '15m'): Candle[] => {
  const data: Candle[] = [];
  const now = new Date();
  
  let intervalMinutes = 15;
  switch(timeframe) {
      case '1m': intervalMinutes = 1; break;
      case '3m': intervalMinutes = 3; break;
      case '5m': intervalMinutes = 5; break;
      case '15m': intervalMinutes = 15; break;
      case '30m': intervalMinutes = 30; break;
      case '1H': intervalMinutes = 60; break;
      case '2H': intervalMinutes = 120; break;
      case '4H': intervalMinutes = 240; break;
      case '8H': intervalMinutes = 480; break;
      case '12H': intervalMinutes = 720; break;
      case '1D': intervalMinutes = 1440; break;
      case '3D': intervalMinutes = 4320; break;
      case '1W': intervalMinutes = 10080; break;
      case '1M': intervalMinutes = 43200; break;
  }

  for (let i = count; i > 0; i--) {
    const time = new Date(now.getTime() - i * intervalMinutes * 60 * 1000); 
    const move = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    const open = currentPrice;
    const close = open + move;
    const high = Math.max(open, close) + Math.random() * 0.5 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    const low = Math.min(open, close) - Math.random() * 0.5 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    currentPrice = close;
    let timeStr = '';
    if (['1D', '3D', '1W', '1M'].includes(timeframe)) {
        timeStr = time.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric' });
    } else {
        timeStr = time.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    }
    data.push({ time: timeStr, open, high, low, close });
  }
  return data;
};

import { Candle, Language, Timeframe, MarketInfo } from './types';

const startPrice = 2030.50;
let currentPrice = startPrice;

export const generateInitialData = (count: number, timeframe: Timeframe = '15m'): Candle[] => {
  const data: Candle[] = [];
  const now = new Date();
  
  let intervalMinutes = 15;
  switch(timeframe) {
      case '1m': intervalMinutes = 1; break;
      case '3m': intervalMinutes = 3; break;
      case '5m': intervalMinutes = 5; break;
      case '15m': intervalMinutes = 15; break;
      case '30m': intervalMinutes = 30; break;
      case '1H': intervalMinutes = 60; break;
      case '2H': intervalMinutes = 120; break;
      case '4H': intervalMinutes = 240; break;
      case '8H': intervalMinutes = 480; break;
      case '12H': intervalMinutes = 720; break;
      case '1D': intervalMinutes = 1440; break;
      case '3D': intervalMinutes = 4320; break;
      case '1W': intervalMinutes = 10080; break;
      case '1M': intervalMinutes = 43200; break;
  }

  for (let i = count; i > 0; i--) {
    const time = new Date(now.getTime() - i * intervalMinutes * 60 * 1000); 
    const move = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    const open = currentPrice;
    const close = open + move;
    const high = Math.max(open, close) + Math.random() * 0.5 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    const low = Math.min(open, close) - Math.random() * 0.5 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    currentPrice = close;
    let timeStr = '';
    if (['1D', '3D', '1W', '1M'].includes(timeframe)) {
        timeStr = time.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric' });
    } else {
        timeStr = time.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    }
    data.push({ time: timeStr, open, high, low, close });
  }
  return data;
};

import { Candle, Language, Timeframe, MarketInfo } from './types';

const startPrice = 2030.50;
let currentPrice = startPrice;

export const generateInitialData = (count: number, timeframe: Timeframe = '15m'): Candle[] => {
  const data: Candle[] = [];
  const now = new Date();
  
  let intervalMinutes = 15;
  switch(timeframe) {
      case '1m': intervalMinutes = 1; break;
      case '3m': intervalMinutes = 3; break;
      case '5m': intervalMinutes = 5; break;
      case '15m': intervalMinutes = 15; break;
      case '30m': intervalMinutes = 30; break;
      case '1H': intervalMinutes = 60; break;
      case '2H': intervalMinutes = 120; break;
      case '4H': intervalMinutes = 240; break;
      case '8H': intervalMinutes = 480; break;
      case '12H': intervalMinutes = 720; break;
      case '1D': intervalMinutes = 1440; break;
      case '3D': intervalMinutes = 4320; break;
      case '1W': intervalMinutes = 10080; break;
      case '1M': intervalMinutes = 43200; break;
  }

  for (let i = count; i > 0; i--) {
    const time = new Date(now.getTime() - i * intervalMinutes * 60 * 1000); 
    const move = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    const open = currentPrice;
    const close = open + move;
    const high = Math.max(open, close) + Math.random() * 0.5 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    const low = Math.min(open, close) - Math.random() * 0.5 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    currentPrice = close;
    let timeStr = '';
    if (['1D', '3D', '1W', '1M'].includes(timeframe)) {
        timeStr = time.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric' });
    } else {
        timeStr = time.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    }
    data.push({ time: timeStr, open, high, low, close });
  }
  return data;
};

import { Candle, Language, Timeframe, MarketInfo } from './types';

const startPrice = 2030.50;
let currentPrice = startPrice;

export const generateInitialData = (count: number, timeframe: Timeframe = '15m'): Candle[] => {
  const data: Candle[] = [];
  const now = new Date();
  
  let intervalMinutes = 15;
  switch(timeframe) {
      case '1m': intervalMinutes = 1; break;
      case '3m': intervalMinutes = 3; break;
      case '5m': intervalMinutes = 5; break;
      case '15m': intervalMinutes = 15; break;
      case '30m': intervalMinutes = 30; break;
      case '1H': intervalMinutes = 60; break;
      case '2H': intervalMinutes = 120; break;
      case '4H': intervalMinutes = 240; break;
      case '8H': intervalMinutes = 480; break;
      case '12H': intervalMinutes = 720; break;
      case '1D': intervalMinutes = 1440; break;
      case '3D': intervalMinutes = 4320; break;
      case '1W': intervalMinutes = 10080; break;
      case '1M': intervalMinutes = 43200; break;
  }

  for (let i = count; i > 0; i--) {
    const time = new Date(now.getTime() - i * intervalMinutes * 60 * 1000); 
    const move = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    const open = currentPrice;
    const close = open + move;
    const high = Math.max(open, close) + Math.random() * 0.5 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    const low = Math.min(open, close) - Math.random() * 0.5 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    currentPrice = close;
    let timeStr = '';
    if (['1D', '3D', '1W', '1M'].includes(timeframe)) {
        timeStr = time.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric' });
    } else {
        timeStr = time.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    }
    data.push({ time: timeStr, open, high, low, close });
  }
  return data;
};

My focus is now on integrating the modal into `TradeView.tsx`, triggering it based on the "Order Confirmation" switch state from `AccountView.tsx`. The modal's visual elements, like the title ("订单确认") and fields (Contract, Side, Leverage, Amount, Price), are being populated. I'm also ensuring the "Don't show again" checkbox correctly disables the "Order Confirmation" setting, thereby suppressing the modal. Meanwhile, system notifications will only be shown if "Popup Notifications" is enabled.

I'm now integrating translations for the new settings' labels and adding state for them within `App.tsx`: `orderConfirmationEnabled` and `popupNotificationsEnabled`. This state and its setters will be passed down to `AccountView.tsx` and used by `triggerNotification` in `App.tsx` and `TradeView.tsx`. In `AccountView`, I'll add the new switches. Finally, the confirmation modal in `TradeView` will respect the "Order Confirmation" setting and the "Don't show again" checkbox will update the global state.


**Fine-tuning Confirm Button**

I'm now focusing on the "Confirm" button's appearance in the order confirmation modal. The current screenshot suggests a bronze hue. I'm considering Tailwind's `bg-amber-800` or a custom HEX code, `#9a6324`, for the color. Concurrently, I've added state variables in `App.tsx` for the new settings (`isOrderConfirmEnabled`, `isPopupNotifyEnabled`) and their setters, passing them down to both `AccountView` and `TradeView`. Furthermore, I've added wrapping logic to trigger notifications. Next up, I need to implement the modal UI and order parameter capture in `TradeView.tsx`.

import { Candle, Language, Timeframe, MarketInfo } from './types';

const startPrice = 2030.50;
let currentPrice = startPrice;

export const generateInitialData = (count: number, timeframe: Timeframe = '15m'): Candle[] => {
  const data: Candle[] = [];
  const now = new Date();
  
  let intervalMinutes = 15;
  switch(timeframe) {
      case '1m': intervalMinutes = 1; break;
      case '3m': intervalMinutes = 3; break;
      case '5m': intervalMinutes = 5; break;
      case '15m': intervalMinutes = 15; break;
      case '30m': intervalMinutes = 30; break;
      case '1H': intervalMinutes = 60; break;
      case '2H': intervalMinutes = 120; break;
      case '4H': intervalMinutes = 240; break;
      case '8H': intervalMinutes = 480; break;
      case '12H': intervalMinutes = 720; break;
      case '1D': intervalMinutes = 1440; break;
      case '3D': intervalMinutes = 4320; break;
      case '1W': intervalMinutes = 10080; break;
      case '1M': intervalMinutes = 43200; break;
  }

  for (let i = count; i > 0; i--) {
    const time = new Date(now.getTime() - i * intervalMinutes * 60 * 1000); 
    const move = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    const open = currentPrice;
    const close = open + move;
    const high = Math.max(open, close) + Math.random() * 0.5 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    const low = Math.min(open, close) - Math.random() * 0.5 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    currentPrice = close;
    let timeStr = '';
    if (['1D', '3D', '1W', '1M'].includes(timeframe)) {
        timeStr = time.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric' });
    } else {
        timeStr = time.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    }
    data.push({ time: timeStr, open, high, low, close });
  }
  return data;
};

**Aligning Modal Styles**

import { Candle, Language, Timeframe, MarketInfo } from './types';

const startPrice = 2030.50;
let currentPrice = startPrice;

export const generateInitialData = (count: number, timeframe: Timeframe = '15m'): Candle[] => {
  const data: Candle[] = [];
  const now = new Date();
  
  let intervalMinutes = 15;
  switch(timeframe) {
      case '1m': intervalMinutes = 1; break;
      case '3m': intervalMinutes = 3; break;
      case '5m': intervalMinutes = 5; break;
      case '15m': intervalMinutes = 15; break;
      case '30m': intervalMinutes = 30; break;
      case '1H': intervalMinutes = 60; break;
      case '2H': intervalMinutes = 120; break;
      case '4H': intervalMinutes = 240; break;
      case '8H': intervalMinutes = 480; break;
      case '12H': intervalMinutes = 720; break;
      case '1D': intervalMinutes = 1440; break;
      case '3D': intervalMinutes = 4320; break;
      case '1W': intervalMinutes = 10080; break;
      case '1M': intervalMinutes = 43200; break;
  }

  for (let i = count; i > 0; i--) {
    const time = new Date(now.getTime() - i * intervalMinutes * 60 * 1000); 
    const move = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    const open = currentPrice;
    const close = open + move;
    const high = Math.max(open, close) + Math.random() * 0.5 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    const low = Math.min(open, close) - Math.random() * 0.5 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    currentPrice = close;
    let timeStr = '';
    if (['1D', '3D', '1W', '1M'].includes(timeframe)) {
        timeStr = time.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric' });
    } else {
        timeStr = time.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    }
    data.push({ time: timeStr, open, high, low, close });
  }
  return data;
};

import { Candle, Language, Timeframe, MarketInfo } from './types';

const startPrice = 2030.50;
let currentPrice = startPrice;

export const generateInitialData = (count: number, timeframe: Timeframe = '15m'): Candle[] => {
  const data: Candle[] = [];
  const now = new Date();
  
  let intervalMinutes = 15;
  switch(timeframe) {
      case '1m': intervalMinutes = 1; break;
      case '3m': intervalMinutes = 3; break;
      case '5m': intervalMinutes = 5; break;
      case '15m': intervalMinutes = 15; break;
      case '30m': intervalMinutes = 30; break;
      case '1H': intervalMinutes = 60; break;
      case '2H': intervalMinutes = 120; break;
      case '4H': intervalMinutes = 240; break;
      case '8H': intervalMinutes = 480; break;
      case '12H': intervalMinutes = 720; break;
      case '1D': intervalMinutes = 1440; break;
      case '3D': intervalMinutes = 4320; break;
      case '1W': intervalMinutes = 10080; break;
      case '1M': intervalMinutes = 43200; break;
  }

  for (let i = count; i > 0; i--) {
    const time = new Date(now.getTime() - i * intervalMinutes * 60 * 1000); 
    const move = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    const open = currentPrice;
    const close = open + move;
    const high = Math.max(open, close) + Math.random() * 0.5 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    const low = Math.min(open, close) - Math.random() * 0.5 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    currentPrice = close;
    let timeStr = '';
    if (['1D', '3D', '1W', '1M'].includes(timeframe)) {
        timeStr = time.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric' });
    } else {
        timeStr = time.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    }
    data.push({ time: timeStr, open, high, low, close });
  }
  return data;
};

import { Candle, Language, Timeframe, MarketInfo } from './types';

const startPrice = 2030.50;
let currentPrice = startPrice;

export const generateInitialData = (count: number, timeframe: Timeframe = '15m'): Candle[] => {
  const data: Candle[] = [];
  const now = new Date();
  
  let intervalMinutes = 15;
  switch(timeframe) {
      case '1m': intervalMinutes = 1; break;
      case '3m': intervalMinutes = 3; break;
      case '5m': intervalMinutes = 5; break;
      case '15m': intervalMinutes = 15; break;
      case '30m': intervalMinutes = 30; break;
      case '1H': intervalMinutes = 60; break;
      case '2H': intervalMinutes = 120; break;
      case '4H': intervalMinutes = 240; break;
      case '8H': intervalMinutes = 480; break;
      case '12H': intervalMinutes = 720; break;
      case '1D': intervalMinutes = 1440; break;
      case '3D': intervalMinutes = 4320; break;
      case '1W': intervalMinutes = 10080; break;
      case '1M': intervalMinutes = 43200; break;
  }

  for (let i = count; i > 0; i--) {
    const time = new Date(now.getTime() - i * intervalMinutes * 60 * 1000); 
    const move = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    const open = currentPrice;
    const close = open + move;
    const high = Math.max(open, close) + Math.random() * 0.5 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    const low = Math.min(open, close) - Math.random() * 0.5 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    currentPrice = close;
    let timeStr = '';
    if (['1D', '3D', '1W', '1M'].includes(timeframe)) {
        timeStr = time.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric' });
    } else {
        timeStr = time.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    }
    data.push({ time: timeStr, open, high, low, close });
  }
  return data;
};

import { Candle, Language, Timeframe, MarketInfo } from './types';

const startPrice = 2030.50;
let currentPrice = startPrice;

export const generateInitialData = (count: number, timeframe: Timeframe = '15m'): Candle[] => {
  const data: Candle[] = [];
  const now = new Date();
  
  let intervalMinutes = 15;
  switch(timeframe) {
      case '1m': intervalMinutes = 1; break;
      case '3m': intervalMinutes = 3; break;
      case '5m': intervalMinutes = 5; break;
      case '15m': intervalMinutes = 15; break;
      case '30m': intervalMinutes = 30; break;
      case '1H': intervalMinutes = 60; break;
      case '2H': intervalMinutes = 120; break;
      case '4H': intervalMinutes = 240; break;
      case '8H': intervalMinutes = 480; break;
      case '12H': intervalMinutes = 720; break;
      case '1D': intervalMinutes = 1440; break;
      case '3D': intervalMinutes = 4320; break;
      case '1W': intervalMinutes = 10080; break;
      case '1M': intervalMinutes = 43200; break;
  }

  for (let i = count; i > 0; i--) {
    const time = new Date(now.getTime() - i * intervalMinutes * 60 * 1000); 
    const move = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    const open = currentPrice;
    const close = open + move;
    const high = Math.max(open, close) + Math.random() * 0.5 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    const low = Math.min(open, close) - Math.random() * 0.5 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    currentPrice = close;
    let timeStr = '';
    if (['1D', '3D', '1W', '1M'].includes(timeframe)) {
        timeStr = time.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric' });
    } else {
        timeStr = time.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    }
    data.push({ time: timeStr, open, high, low, close });
  }
  return data;
};

import { Candle, Language, Timeframe, MarketInfo } from './types';

const startPrice = 2030.50;
let currentPrice = startPrice;

export const generateInitialData = (count: number, timeframe: Timeframe = '15m'): Candle[] => {
  const data: Candle[] = [];
  const now = new Date();
  
  let intervalMinutes = 15;
  switch(timeframe) {
      case '1m': intervalMinutes = 1; break;
      case '3m': intervalMinutes = 3; break;
      case '5m': intervalMinutes = 5; break;
      case '15m': intervalMinutes = 15; break;
      case '30m': intervalMinutes = 30; break;
      case '1H': intervalMinutes = 60; break;
      case '2H': intervalMinutes = 120; break;
      case '4H': intervalMinutes = 240; break;
      case '8H': intervalMinutes = 480; break;
      case '12H': intervalMinutes = 720; break;
      case '1D': intervalMinutes = 1440; break;
      case '3D': intervalMinutes = 4320; break;
      case '1W': intervalMinutes = 10080; break;
      case '1M': intervalMinutes = 43200; break;
  }

  for (let i = count; i > 0; i--) {
    const time = new Date(now.getTime() - i * intervalMinutes * 60 * 1000); 
    const move = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    const open = currentPrice;
    const close = open + move;
    const high = Math.max(open, close) + Math.random() * 0.5 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    const low = Math.min(open, close) - Math.random() * 0.5 * (intervalMinutes / 15);
    currentPrice = close;
    let timeStr = '';
    if (['1D', '3D', '1W', '1M'].includes(timeframe)) {
        timeStr = time.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric' });
    } else {
        timeStr = time.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    }
    data.push({ time: timeStr, open, high, low, close });
  }
  return data;
};
